$comment: The loading screen on joining a world (and on respawning): it shows until the full-detail chunks of the near ring around the player are generated, lit, meshed and drawn, or for at most timeoutS, and the player does not move until it opens (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3). radiusChunks: the near ring is the server's view sphere of this radius (chunks c with |c − the player's chunk|² ≤ r² + r, as the server streams them), so it is at most the server's viewRadiusChunks (shared/protocol/constants.json): every chunk it waits for is streamed without being asked for. timeoutS: past this the screen opens whatever has loaded (the game then waits for collision's ±1 chunk as before). Opt out for testing with ?loading=off or the dwell.loading store set to "off". fade: when it opens the screen turns to color (bright, near-white) for holdS, then fades out over durationS with an ease-out (opacity (1 − t)^easePower), uncovering the view and the HUD together; on a CPU (software) adapter over cpuDurationS, and with prefers-reduced-motion over reducedMotionDurationS (0: none). Run `node shared/look/loading.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-game/src/loading.gen.rs or client/src/ui/loading.gen.ts is stale.

respawnPreload.$comment: Preloading the respawn point while the death screen shows (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.3): from a death until the respawn, the server streams the view sphere of radiusChunks around where the player will respawn as a second, smaller streaming centre (after the view around the body, within the same bandwidth), and the client lights and meshes those chunks after its own near ring, so the loading screen on respawning finds them ready. enabled false: the respawn streams only once the player is there. radiusChunks: at most viewRadiusChunks; the loading screen's radiusChunks is the useful value. Generated into crates/dwell-game/src/loading.gen.rs and crates/dwell-sim/src/respawn_preload.gen.rs.
